declared_before: any challenger fit or any challenger metric on any fold
defect_targeted: Phase 1B per-minute rate: prior-season history carried forward unprojected (no development / role-change adjustment) and a position-only shrinkage target (no role conditioning). Evidence: d1 A1 decomposition (rate part dominates; realized/model PTS rate 1.069 at current<10% of history vs 0.950 at >=75%; role-change slope 0.122 +- 0.007 where the blend dominates, 0.001 +- 0.003 where current evidence dominates).
structure: rate_t = (cur_t + sum_j w_j * G_tj * h_jt + k_t * prior_pos_t * exp(gamma_t * z)) / (cur_min + sum_j w_j * h_jmin + k_t); G_tj = exp(alpha_t * j + beta_t * clip(D, -1.5, 1.5)); D = log(max(min_mu,1) / max(h1 minutes per appearance,1)) when h1_n_app >= 5 else 0; z = log(max(min_mu,1) / 20). w_j, k_t, prior_pos_t, minutes model, dispersion and PMF construction UNCHANGED.
parameters: 3 per stat (alpha_t, beta_t, gamma_t), stats PTS REB AST FG3M STL BLK TOV fitted independently (no shared shrinkage).
fit_objective: Poisson log likelihood of y_t given exposure y_min * rate_t (realized minutes: isolates the rate) on PLAYED rows of the TRAINING folds only.
level_control: both arms get a per-stat level factor L_t = sum y / sum(y_min * rate) fitted on the same training rows (mimics the JM1 GLM intercept, so the comparison is on geometry, not on level).

chronology.prospective_holdout: 2026-27 live season (frozen production forecasts + actuals), never used for fitting

holdout_contamination_note: the A1 descriptive decomposition that motivated the hypothesis pooled F2024-F2026; no parameter is fitted on F2026 and no structure choice is made after reading any F2026 challenger metric.
evaluation_pmf: NB(min_mu * L_t * rate_t, phi_t) via props_v0.pmf_matrix (the 1B marginal); metrics on PLAYED rows: log loss, RPS, mean error, Brier and P(OVER) calibration at the synthetic line floor(mu_incumbent)+0.5; by stat x role (min_mu buckets), evidence share, role change, early season, transfer.
promotion_gate_A: aggregate log loss and RPS improve on the F2026 holdout for every stat with a fitted |effect| (paired, game-clustered 95% upper bound < 0), and no stat worse than +0.0005 log loss
no stat x role cell worse than +0.002 log loss (upper bound)
calibration-in-the-large: max |realized/model rate - 1| over role and evidence buckets decreases for PTS and AST
early season (season_day <= 30) not worse for any stat
prospective: on the live 2026-27 played player-games, mean error by role decreases for PTS/AST without degrading REB
then the production implementation must reproduce the research rates exactly and pass the walk-forward refit + full CI

failed: gate 3: AST max |realized/model - 1| rises 0.186 -> 0.311 (NO_HISTORY cell, n~380: role-conditional prior applied to first appearances)
gate 4: TOV early-season log loss +0.00035 (point estimate)

revision_A2.single_change: z = 0 (position-only prior, as the incumbent) for rows with no minutes history at all (H_min == 0); everything else identical to A
revision_A2.mechanism: the role-conditional prior is identified from players with history (low min_mu = low demonstrated role/skill); for a first appearance min_mu reflects minutes-model uncertainty, not skill

evaluation.primary: prospective 2026-27 live season (production pregame rate components reconstructed read-only on the Droplet; never fitted on)
evaluation.secondary: F2026 second look, flagged as holdout reuse

revision_A2.gate: same promotion_gate_A; criteria 3-4 judged on the primary (live) holdout

outcome_A2.per_stat_rule: a stat failing any pre-declared criterion keeps the incumbent rate (stated with the decision; gate criteria unchanged)

not_promoted.TOV: F2026 early season + live aggregate worse
